steps.content:
<color=#dg1f1f><size=60>Offer no glance to the departed.
Lend no ear to the abyss.
Speak no question to the spirits.</color></size>

The rift convulses, folding in on itself like a wounded thing. It seals with a soundless finality, swallowing the copper coin that has turned into the coffin ghost, the phantom in the ghost's grip, and that warning. All of it, gone.
Lichen rushes toward the last shimmering traces, and crimson flames leap from her fingertips.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Heaven and earth overturned; Yin and Yang reversed!
The rift does not yield quietly. It lashes out, a violent surge of crimson flame that throws her backward. She can only watch as the Void of Yin's tear seals shut completely.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...Nngh!
Are you alright?

You catch her before she falls. Carefully, you lift her sleeve; beneath it, the wound that had only just begun to mend has torn itself open again. Blood wells, trails down her wrist, falls in slow drops to the mud below. But...
She laughs.

The sound is fractured, unfamiliar, echoing through the mist like something that does not belong to her. Around you, the rift has sealed. The evil spirits have withdrawn. Lichen stands at your side. And yet the air grows colder. The light withdraws. The world holds its breath.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...After all this, just a little more... and still they try to stop me... every single time...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: It's unfair...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I will show you...

The last echo of laughter fades into a heavy silence. A shadow passes over Lichen's features, her playful demeanor gone. She starts forming hand seals, and from the space between her fingers, golden runes flow. It isn't until you see them that the connection is made:
The other "Lichen" bears these very same symbols.
A spike of raw alarm shoots through you, and your grip on her tightens.
That monster didn't hurt your shifu. I saw it. It fled into the Void of Yin with her. Your shifu's still out there. She's safe. You're the one bleeding right now.
Let's stop for a moment. Let me tend to your wound, and then we'll figure out the next move. Okay?
Your words fail to ease the tension.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: The Dao I seek is right before me, yet you'd have me retreat for the sake of safety? Hah... Do I look that faint of heart?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Worry not. Since that coffin ghost appeared... the one commanding the copper coin must be near. They will protect you.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I will not be staying. My mind is still racing, and besides... I still have to go after my shifu.

She reaches up to pat your head as usual, but her movements are stiff, mechanical. Her gaze is locked on the distance, the exact direction the coffin ghost fled, deep into the ruined city. Flames flicker to life among the runes on her fingers, and on the air, faintly, you hear the drone of chaos.
A cold spike of dread pierces through you. Without heeding the danger, you grab her hand and force it down, crushing the flames in your shared grip. You have to stop her.
The motion finally breaks her trance. Slowly, she turns to look at you.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Why are you still trying to stop me?
A single glance from her sends a chill through you, her tone ice-cold. You grit your teeth and hold your ground.
...The Void of Yin is too dangerous. You won't survive it. Last time you forced your way in, the backlash nearly killed you. And now you're alone...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: But I brought you back, did I not? This time, I will do the same for my shifu.
Lichen's gaze darkens, the light in it guttering like a candle in a void. You search her eyes desperately, looking for a trace of her—the one you know.

But that familiarity is a trap. It only shows you the other "Lichen" reflected in this one. The fearlessness and irreverence, the resolve and obsession, the wildness teetering on madness—they've always tangled in her, separated not by the barrier between the two worlds but merely by a fleeting thought.
...You have to hold her back. By any means necessary.

options: You can't do this alone. I have to come with you...

steps.content: Your grip on her hand tightens slowly, as you channel your strength into the shackles.
The Mania here is too thin to summon the red spikes, but it's enough for her to sense something at work. Enough for her to feel the strange, unusual connection blooming between you.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: This is...?
...Seems like some kind of spell. It protects me from time to time when I'm in the Void of Yin.

Last time you forced your way in, you barely made it a few steps before the Void's backlash tore into you. I panicked and somehow threw up this spell to shield you. You're deep enough in the craft, so you must've felt it, right? Without it, we'd probably both be dead.
This is the real <color=#fb9259>key</color> to crossing between worlds. If you want to enter the Void of Yin and bring your shifu back, rushing in alone won't work. You need me.
She says nothing. Her gaze drops to your clasped hands, resting there like a weight. What she's thinking, you cannot tell.
You take a deep breath, withdraw the shackles, and soften your voice:

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You said it yourself: "Cross each bridge as it comes." In plain terms, every problem's got a solution, and you just need the right one, right? I'm that solution. Or at least, better than you going solo.
She offers no response.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And if that's not enough, you also said to adapt and wait for the right moment. Whether it's finding your shifu or chasing the Dao of Heaven, there's no rush. The more impatient you are, the further you'll be.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Maybe we wait here for the others? Once everyone's regrouped, our odds get a lot better. Don't you think?

Silence stretches between you. Then, finally, she looks up. Her eyes travel from your intertwined hands to your face, and when they lock with yours, a faint smile curves her lips, encouraging you to continue.
You steel yourself.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...If you're really that anxious, I'll go. I'll find her for you. Right now.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I know that place. I can catch up. I'll try to reason with that copper coin, and if that fails... I'll help your shifu take the monster down. My "spell" works better in the Void of Yin. I'll bring her back to you. I promise.

Will this even work? You catch the faint shadow that passes through her eyes. Annoyance? Suspicion? Or are you just seeing things, hoping and fearing in equal measure? Regardless, you keep holding her hand tightly.
Then she laughs—soft, almost fond—and tilts her head back. When she speaks, her voice is leisurely, amused:

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...No wonder my divination said I would meet a sage and have my wishes granted. It seems the prophecy was true. You have guided me through confusion time and again, young friend. Every word you speak holds truth.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Blinded by a single leaf... Yes. I was so desperate to find my shifu, so eager to break into the Void of Yin, that obsession clouded my sight. I didn't even notice...
She's still smiling, but her eyes are cold. They narrow as they trace over you with an interest that feels less like recognition and more like appraisal.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: You are the remarkable one, young friend. Such power, such wit and nerve, such insight and magnanimity...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Since when did our guide grow into someone I barely recognize? You no longer resemble that "child" at all.
She raises her hand as if to pat your head again, but her fingers trail along the side of your face instead. They press gently against your skin, tracing the shape of the bones beneath.
You stiffen at the touch, every instinct screaming. Then you force it down. You puff out your cheeks, straighten your back, and let your voice climb higher, sweeter, deliberately childish:
But there's a condition! You have to promise to stay here. Don't run off before I'm back. Wait for me. Because...

...I-I scare easy. If something happens, I can't make it back alone. I need someone up here to pull me out, to yank me back the second things go wrong. You've got Daoist arts, right? Only you can do that!
She watches you for a long moment. Finally, her gaze seems to soften, and she nods.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Hehe... You speak truly, young friend. I was too narrow-minded.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Perhaps following your lead is the wiser path.
She withdraws her hand seals and steps back, her expression settling into something almost calm. Did you manage to reach her? The breath you've been holding loosens, just slightly.

This is for the best. She has to stay behind. If she ventures deeper into the Void of Yin, she'll only break more rules without a second thought. That place belongs to the dead, governed by the rules of the phantoms. And if something happens to her there...
You can't foresee the consequences. That uncertainty is what truly terrifies you.

This is for the best. Lichen understands now. She can't go alone. And once you leave her sight and head in—whether you find the copper coin, the coffin ghost, or the other "Lichen"—you'll deal with it.
Instinct screams beneath your thoughts: You must not let the two Lichens meet. No matter what.
You've figured it out. You have a plan. Then a finger presses against your chest. Its tip blazes, heat scorching the entire index finger red-hot.
A vermillion rune materializes from thin air, slamming into you like a brand. It merges with your flesh, sinks deep, and leaves no trace behind.
This is...?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: A protection talisman. Keep it close... The enemy you face this time is no small matter. With this, I can offer you some safety for a while longer, just as I did before.

You open your mouth to ask, but she reaches out first. One finger presses gently against the space between your brows. Then, the world bleeds away, slowly sinking into darkness like ink spreading through water.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Go now, young friend. I will be waiting for your answer.
In this vast expanse of nothing, her cyan eyes remain fixed on you—watching, ever watching.
